description:
Your guide for home remodeling. I'm a flooring and remodeling contractor and I'm here to help navigate through all those tough questions, from product selection to what the process of remodeling will look like. Lets tackle those projects!

I try to respond to as many comments as I can get to but as your support has grown it has become increasingly difficult. I've now enabled the Super Thanks button on all of my videos as a way to guarantee a response to your questions. If you want to support a video you found particular value in, or you want to make sure you get a response to an inquiry, you can now utilize the thanks button in the menu under my videos. Thanks for your continued support!
